objective: Round 3 Phase 1: Server-Verified Role-Based Security with genuine server-verified authentication, database-recorded memberships, strict Express authorization middleware, cross-workspace access blocking, confidential data redaction, and anonymous demo preservation.
acceptance_criteria: Database migration for workspace_members table with RLS enabled and StorageRepository implementation
Server-verified authentication middleware (backend/middleware/auth.ts) supporting Supabase Auth and HMAC dev tokens
Authoritative role resolution via server records in backend/middleware/roleAuth.ts with strict rejection of client-supplied role headers
Dual-space architecture segregating anonymous demo workspaces (ws_anon_*) from protected workspaces (ws_proj_*)
Express authorization middleware guarding all sensitive endpoints across workspaces, handovers, conflicts, sources, findings, and analysis
Server-side redaction utility (src/server/security/redactor.ts) filtering CONFIDENTIAL citations and stripping reviewer notes for External users
Preservation of zero-auth public demo accessibility in Incognito mode with visual Demo Perspective Switcher
Interactive UI role adaptation in Header, ReviewView, and HandoverView
Comprehensive automated security test suite in src/__tests__/roleSecurity.test.mjs covering all 11 security scenarios
All 149 existing tests continue passing without regression (161 total tests passing)
Clean production builds for both Express backend and Next.js frontend
non_goals: Do not implement Phase 2 GitHub integration or Phase 3 continuous knowledge updates during Phase 1
Do not break the zero-auth public demo journey or Incognito browser accessibility
Do not expose service role credentials or database keys in API responses or frontend client bundles
Do not weaken database RLS policies

verification.command: npm test && npm run backend:build && npm run frontend:build
verification.result: 161 of 161 automated tests passed across all 10 test suites (Phase 1 Role Security: 11 tests, Phase D: 15 tests, Phase I: 20 tests, Phase E: 23 tests, Phase F: 16 tests, Persistence: 9 tests, Phase C: 13 tests, Phase H Supabase: 18 tests, Handover Generation/Integrity: 36 tests). Standalone Express backend compiles to dist/backend/server.js (207.1 KB) in 11ms. Frontend compiles to Next.js production bundle with 0 errors across all routes. All 11 security scenarios verified: role header spoofing blocked (403), expired tokens rejected (401), forged signatures rejected (401), cross-workspace access denied (403), anonymous access to protected workspaces blocked (401), developer certification blocked (403), developer conflict resolution blocked (403), member invitation restricted to managers (201/403), confidential citations redacted for external role, public share links securely verified without leaking credentials, and workspace claim security (unauthenticated claim 401, initial claim 200/Manager, duplicate claim 409).
